answer: Reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so influence must be earned through sustained, honest service rather than a brief burst of activity. In the EigenTrust-style matrix, a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality: without reciprocal endorsements from established peers, transitivity cannot amplify its score, and it cannot pass consensus. Willow, ferrous, and yarrow identities likewise gain weight only by building durable, verifiable trust over time.
